description: The YAML MarathonTestParseCommand writes for `parse -o` (its own ObjectMapper, taken by reflection): ParseCommandResult(tests, flakyTests).
generator: tools/oracle/module (run tools/oracle/jcompat-tables or the corpus wrappers to regenerate)

description: meta properties with values of several types

yaml.ok:
---
tests:
- pkg: "com.example"
  clazz: "FooTest"
  method: "testBar"
  metaProperties:
  - name: "org.junit.Test"
    values: {}
  - name: "Owner"
    values:
      value: "me"
      "n": 3
      d: 1.5
      b: true
      list:
      - "a"
      - 1
flakyTests:
- pkg: "com.example"
  clazz: "FooTest"
  method: "testBar"
  metaProperties: []
